patch_sets.summary: Adds the flavour's name to Wine's version string.

patches.name: vulkan-portability-enumeration
patches.summary: Let Wine's Vulkan find MoltenVK (portability enumeration)

header.why: MoltenVK is a portability driver; without this the loader hides it.

patches.name: ntdll-vulkan-bundled-driver
patches.summary: Point the Vulkan loader at the bundled MoltenVK driver

header.why: The loader only searches its build prefix for driver manifests.

patches.name: winegcc-deterministic-temp-dir
patches.summary: Name winegcc's temp directory deterministically, for reproducible builds

patches.name: dwrite-tests-fno-builtin
patches.summary: Build the dwrite tests with `-fno-builtin` so they link with LLVM 23

patches.name: ntdll-version-label
patches.summary: Add the flavour's name to `wine --version`

patches.name: ntdll-msync
patches.summary: msync: Mach-semaphore synchronisation, on with `WINEMSYNC=1`

header.why: Faster than wineserver round trips for programs with many threads.

patches.name: ntdll-rosetta-debug-registers
patches.summary: Rosetta 2: report success when setting debug registers

header.why: Rosetta 2 can't set x86 debug registers; DRM checks abort when it fails.

patches.name: ntdll-rosetta-mxcsr
patches.summary: Rosetta 2: mask MXCSR bits it rejects <before> LDMXCSR & friends

header.why:
Rosetta raises #GP for reserved MXCSR bits.
Programs built with old MSVC set them.
header.evidence: Sikarugir 10.0_8's ntdll.so has the same check.

patches.name: advapi32-battlenet-acls
patches.summary: Battle.net: grant the permissions its updater checks for

patches.name: ntdll-rosetta-cross-process-code-writes
patches.summary: Rosetta 2: flush translations after another process writes code

header.why: Rosetta caches translated code.
header.uncertain: Rebuilt from compiled code; the original's intent is a guess.

patches.name: winemac-gl-update-on-main-thread
patches.summary: Update OpenGL contexts on the main thread

header.why: AppKit requires it; off the main thread it crashes on macOS 14 and later.

build_info.flavour_description: WineHQ's release plus fixes for running Windows programs on a Mac.
